name: zvideo_fxpass3_copy_surface_pixel_to_scratch_clipped
description: zVideo::FxPass3_CopySurfacePixelToScratchClipped copies one biased 16-bit FX surface pixel into the pass-3 scratch buffer only when source and destination endpoints are inside the active clip bounds.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zVideo FxPass3 source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x48da60 validates fastcall dst deltas in ECX/EDX, pushed source deltas, current scratch offset biasing, strict clip checks for both endpoints, source indexing through g_zVideo_FxSurfacePitchPixels16, and scratch indexing through g_zVideo_FxSurfaceWidth.

The native FxPass3 smoke verifies an in-bounds copy from the active FX surface to the scratch buffer and verifies rejection when either the destination endpoint or source endpoint falls outside the active pass-3 clip rectangle.
